title: Resolution Carving — turning broad systems into inspectable chains
canonical_rule: Do not move or replace the ten canonical tree levels. Add resolution beneath them.
purpose: The repository already has broad ontologies and sector maps. This round identifies the next resolution step: every broad noun should eventually open into a chain of objects, institutions, flows, controls, time, geography and evidence.

resolution_patterns.country: territory → population → constitution → government → revenue → expenditure → debt → public services → productive sectors → infrastructure → trade → ownership → external dependencies → historical change
resolution_patterns.company: legal entity → owners → voting control → subsidiaries → assets → operators → employees → suppliers → customers → financing → procurement → regulators → geography → strategic dependencies
resolution_patterns.energy: resource → extraction/import → processing → generation/conversion → storage → transmission → distribution → price → user/industry → emissions → regulation → ownership → decommissioning
resolution_patterns.infrastructure: asset → location → owner → operator → capacity → users → inputs → maintenance → financing → regulation → failure modes → redundancy → repair → cross-border dependency
resolution_patterns.religion: text/tradition → interpretation → doctrine → ritual → community → institution → property → education/charity/media → population → geography → law → politics → historical change
resolution_patterns.politics: idea → ideology → organization/movement → manifesto → candidate/leader → voters → election → office → coalition → law → budget → implementation → outcome → public response
resolution_patterns.culture: creator → work → medium → publisher/platform → distribution → audience → reception → imitation/adaptation → community → market → archive → generational change
resolution_patterns.science: question → observation → experiment/model → measurement → dataset → publication → critique/replication → theory → engineering → prototype → standard → manufacturing → deployment
resolution_patterns.finance: actor → account/claim → instrument → counterparty → cash flow → collateral → maturity → settlement → ownership/control → regulator → risk → historical change
resolution_patterns.history: condition → actors → decision → event → location → material effect → legal/institutional response → population effect → investigation → memory → inherited constraint
resolution_patterns.information: source → record → archive/database → transformation → publisher → platform → distribution → audience → reaction → correction/contest → archive/version

cross_domain_carving.food: soil → water → seed → farm → labour → machinery → fertilizer/feed → processing → logistics → retailer → household → waste → soil
cross_domain_carving.housing: land → planning law → developer/owner → finance → construction → utility connection → dwelling → rent/ownership → household → maintenance → inheritance/transfer
cross_domain_carving.health: population → risk/exposure → primary care → diagnosis → laboratory → treatment → medicine/device → payment/insurance → outcome → public-health data → research
cross_domain_carving.education: child/person → family → school → curriculum → teacher/labour → funding → building/technology → assessment → credential → labour market → income/productivity
cross_domain_carving.trade: resource/producer → contract → finance → port/rail/road → customs → logistics → importer → processing → final user → payment → data record

north_programme_resolution.rule: These are research graph connections, not assertions that all listed actors form one political alliance. Each empirical edge must acquire its own source and date.

evidence_resolution.missingness: A missing relationship is a research gap, not evidence of absence. A failed search should record corpus, date and query scope where useful.

next_carving_targets: Promote high-value research questions into actual node records only when definitions and evidence roles are clear.
Attach authoritative data to country finance, energy, labour and demographic records.
Build ownership/control chains for strategic infrastructure and major firms.
Build event ledgers that join history to places, institutions, law and infrastructure.
Replicate the Christianity research depth for other major religious traditions.
Expand the spatial model from coordinates toward evidence-bearing relationship inspection.
Keep the Potatoverse symbolic layer rich while explicitly separated from empirical claims.
